en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, no author known. 'Да зажарват' I render 'will be jealous' (literally 'will burn'); 'Клепки има, очи нема' is a poetic image I read as 'I have lashes but no eyes (nothing to see with) since he does not come'; my reading.

lines.en: - Change your clothes, Sute, dress up,

lines.cyr: па излези, Суте мори, на портето.
lines.lat: pa izlezi, Sute mori, na porteto.
lines.en: and come out, Sute dear, to the gate.
Your mother-in-law will see you, Sute,

lines.cyr: ќе ти даде, Суте мори, голем бакшиш.
lines.lat: ḱe ti dade, Sute mori, golem bakšiš.
lines.en: she will give you, Sute dear, a big tip.
A big tip, Sute, a row of gold coins,
a row of gold coins, Sute dear, mamudiye coins.

lines.cyr: Да ги врзеш, Суте, на гушата,
lines.lat: Da gi vrzeš, Sute, na gušata,
lines.en: Tie them, Sute, around your neck,

lines.cyr: да зажарват, Суте мори, твоите друшки.
lines.lat: da zažarvat, Sute mori, tvoite druški.
lines.en: so your friends, Sute dear, will be jealous.

lines.cyr: - Не ја чекам, мајко, свекрва ми,
lines.lat: - Ne ja čekam, majko, svekrva mi,
lines.en: - I am not waiting, mother, for my mother-in-law,

lines.cyr: туку си го чекам, мајко, моето либе.
lines.lat: tuku si go čekam, majko, moeto libe.
lines.en: but I am waiting, mother, for my sweetheart.
There are lashes, mother, but no eyes,

lines.cyr: штом не иде, мила мајко, да ме земе.
lines.lat: štom ne ide, mila majko, da me zeme.
lines.en: since he does not come, dear mother, to take me.
